descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S03 Existing specs: Hospital task review has Copy Text and no email path; the Copy Text builder never merges same-name patients and never prints a missing room

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U3 Copy Text copies the whole list (pending and completed) to the clipboard in the same grouping, every task under its patient; the copy stays on the device (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given task-export.spec.ts: two Hospital patients both named 'Task Probe Alpha' (rooms 31 and 32), one open task each. api/tasks-export.spec.ts: task groups for 'Ada Lovelace' (Room 12) and 'Grace Hopper' (no room); two 'J. Smith' patients in rooms 3 and 9

When Open /rounding/tasks, tap Copy Text, read the clipboard; build the Copy Text output from the fixtures

Then Heading 'Pending Tasks'; no button named Email and no mailto link; both rooms and both tasks shown; the clipboard has each patient heading with its own task; each heading carries only its own tasks; a patient without a room has no location; the two J. Smith patients are two groups; no 'undefined'

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions (the only lane that reads the real clipboard today). Evidence for U9 (Hospital) and for the pending part of U2/U3 on the screen and in the builder; no completed task is involved, so they say nothing about 'completed at the bottom' or AC 4's 'whole list' (S01, S02). A failure names the failing test, so screen and builder can be told apart

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-07 Task Export · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-07/S03

Existing specs: Hospital task review has Copy Text and no email path; the Copy Text builder never merges same-name patients and never prints a missing room

Tickets: TFA-92585 Task Export (ready for pr)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-07.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/tasks-export.spec.ts [api] — the export lists each patient's pending tasks, with a location only when there is one — expected
  • api/tasks-export.spec.ts [api] — two patients who share a name are two groups, not one — expected
  • task-export.spec.ts [chromium] — the hospital task review has Copy and no email path — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A: Tim's Playwright spec runs on the local stack only.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
